ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: in the left map, Jia is located near southeastern North America; the map marks about the 30° parallel and the 80° meridian, so Jia can be read as being approximately near 30°N, 80°W. In the right map, Yi is located near inland Asia; the map marks about the 40° parallel and the 100° meridian, so Yi can be read as being approximately near 40°N, 100°E. Reasoning: the question asks for the “shortest distance” between the two cities, which should be estimated according to the great-circle distance between two points on the earth’s sphere. The longitude difference between the two places is about 80°+100°=180°, and the latitudes are respectively about φ1=30°N and φ2=40°N. From the great-circle central angle formula: cos c = sinφ1 sinφ2 + cosφ1 cosφ2 cosΔλ. Substituting Δλ≈180°, the central angle c is about 110°. On the great circle of the earth’s surface, each 1° is about 111 kilometers, so the distance is about 110×111≈12210 kilometers, that is, about 12,200 kilometers; taking an approximation, it is about 12,000 kilometers.

raw_record.question_text:
In the following figure, places Jia and Yi are world-famous spaceflight centers.

<image1>

Approximately how many kilometers is the shortest distance between the cities Jia and Yi?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：左图甲位于30°N附近、80°W附近，右图乙位于40°N附近、100°E附近。再根据题意要求“最短距离”，把两城看作球面两点，取经度差Δλ≈180°、纬度φ1≈30°N、φ2≈40°N。代入大圆距离关系，得到中心角约110°，再乘以每度约111千米，得约1.22万千米，按选项/近似取1.20万千米。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：左侧地图中，甲位于北美东南部附近，图上标有约30°纬线和80°经线，可读作甲大致在30°N、80°W附近。右侧地图中，乙位于亚洲内陆附近，图上标有约40°纬线和100°经线，可读作乙大致在40°N、100°E附近。
推理：题目问两城间的“最短距离”，应按地球球面上两点的大圆距离估算。两地经度差约为80°+100°=180°，纬度分别约为φ1=30°N、φ2=40°N。由大圆中心角公式：cos c = sinφ1 sinφ2 + cosφ1 cosφ2 cosΔλ。代入Δλ≈180°，得到中心角c约为110°。地球表面大圆上每1°约为111千米，所以距离约为110×111≈12210千米，即约1.22万千米，按近似取约1.20万千米。
